verdict.rationale: Bevy's own site links to a community assets/plugins page (bevy-docs-17) confirming an ecosystem of third-party assets, plugins, and apps exists, and crates.io shows real usage (bevy-probe-rt-1). However, community evidence indicates the ecosystem is still young/thin (bevy-probe-rt-2 notes nascent tooling like a 70-star MCP plugin) and developers report gaps in built-in tooling (e.g., UI widgets forcing a switch to egui, bevy-comm-16), unlike a mature large-scale asset store. Missing for 10: quantified size/maturity of the asset store, evidence of a curated marketplace, and independent corroboration of ecosystem breadth comparable to established engines.
